Launch blue at the weakest-gravity phase; same mass and impulse.

setup: Apply the same upward impulse at two phases of the gravity cycle.
name: Oscillating gravity

oracle.name: Oscillating gravity
oracle.law: Global gravity varies as g(t)=g_0[1+0.3sin(2π t/6)], oscillating with a six-second period.
oracle.plain: Gravity gets stronger and weaker in a six-second cycle.
oracle.plain_zh: 重力每六秒完成一次由强到弱、再变强的循环。
oracle.condition: The same launch is repeated at different times.
oracle.effect: Gravity oscillates from 0.7g₀ to 1.3g₀ with a six-count period.
oracle.scope: The change is global and continuous during each flight.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
